Export pins

To keep these pins for good, copy the text below and send it to whoever looks after this wallpaper's index.html. They replace everything between the [ and ] of window.MY_PINS (near the top of the scripts, just above the clock settings) with it and save the file. The list already includes the pins that are there now. Pins listed there always show, even if the wallpaper's storage is cleared.
